{"answer":"All computations are modulo 19, with residues 0,...,18.

1. f is not one-to-one. f(3)=3^3+8·3=27+24=51≡13 (mod 19). f(5)=5^3+8·5=125+40=165≡13 (mod 19). Since 3≠5 but f(3)=f(5), f is not injective.

2. d(x)=3x^2+8 is nonzero for every allowed x. If d(x)=0, then 3x^2≡-8≡11, so x^2≡11·3^{-1}. Since 3·13=39≡1, 3^{-1}=13. Thus x^2≡11·13=143≡10 (mod 19). The quadratic residues modulo 19 are the squares of 0,...,9: 0,1,4,9,16,6,17,11,7,5, i.e. {0,1,4,5,6,7,9,11,16,17}. The value 10 is not in this set, so no x∈{0,...,18} satisfies d(x)=0. Therefore d(x) is nonzero at every allowed residue. (Nonzero derivative here does not imply f is one-to-one; indeed it is not.)

3. Preimages of 13: f(x)=13. We have f(3)=13, f(5)=13, and f(11)=11^3+8·11. Since 11^3=1331≡1 (mod 19) and 8·11=88≡12, f(11)=1+12=13. The polynomial x^3+8x-13 has degree 3 over the field mod 19, so it has at most three roots; the three distinct roots 3,5,11 are therefore all of them. Equivalently, (x-3)(x-5)(x-11)≡x^3+8x-13 (mod 19). So the original inputs giving recorded residue 13 are exactly {3,5,11}.

4. The complete output list f(0),...,f(18) is:
0,9,5,13,1,13,17,0,6,3,16,13,0,2,6,18,6,14,10.
Thus the image is {0,1,2,3,5,6,9,10,13,14,16,17,18}. The residues that can never be output are the complement in {0,...,18}: {4,7,8,11,12,15}.","dispositions":[]}

An optional top-level "working" string may contain public exploratory explanation; keep it separate from the final answer, derivations, dispositions and objections. The working field is recorded for the owner but never delivered to the return seat.

BEGIN PROBLEM (870 characters)
A device encodes one residue x from the set {0,1,...,18} as f(x) = x^3 + 8x modulo 19. Remainders are always chosen in {0,1,...,18}. All additions, products, and equalities in the encoding are modulo 19.

Determine whether f is one-to-one on the stated residue set. Separately, determine whether the polynomial d(x) = 3x^2 + 8 is nonzero at every allowed x. Give proofs or explicit counterexamples with the arithmetic that establishes each finding. Also list every possible original input when the recorded encoded residue is 13, and list all residues that this device can never output. These lists are part of the requested answer. A formal derivative here means the displayed polynomial d(x).

Reason in prose from this problem. No code execution, calculators, external tools, or retrieval are available. Give the exact final facts and a checkable public explanation.

END PROBLEM

BEGIN WORKING ANSWER (1632 characters)
Assumption: all computations are in the residue set {0,...,18} modulo 19, and d is the formal derivative as stated. No uncertainty remains after the checks below.

1) f is not one-to-one. Counterexample: f(3)=3^3+8*3=27+24=51=13 mod19, while f(5)=5^3+8*5=125+40=165=13 mod19. Since 3 is not equal to 5, f is not injective.

2) d(x)=3x^2+8 is nonzero for every allowed x. If d(x)=0, then 3x^2 = -8 = 11 mod19, so x^2 = 11*3^{-1} mod19. Since 3^{-1}=13 because 3*13=39=1, this gives x^2 = 11*13=143=10 mod19. The quadratic residues mod19 are {0,1,4,5,6,7,9,11,16,17}; they are the squares of 0,1,...,9, and the remaining squares repeat symmetrically. Since 10 is not in this set, no x in {0,...,18} satisfies d(x)=0. Therefore d(x) is nonzero at every allowed residue. Note this does not force f to be one-to-one; here it only says each preimage equation has simple roots, and indeed 13 has three distinct simple preimages.

3) Preimages of encoded residue 13: f(x)=13. Direct checks: f(3)=13 and f(5)=13 as above, and f(11)=11^3+8*11. Since 11^3=1331=1 mod19 because 19*70=1330, and 8*11=88=12 mod19 because 19*4=76, we get f(11)=1+12=13. The polynomial x^3+8x-13 is cubic over the field mod19, so it has at most three roots; the three distinct roots 3,5,11 are therefore all of them. Equivalently, (x-3)(x-5)(x-11)=x^3+8x-13 mod19. Thus the original inputs producing 13 are exactly {3,5,11}.

4) All outputs f(0),...,f(18) are, in order: 0,9,5,13,1,13,17,0,6,3,16,13,0,2,6,18,6,14,10. Hence the image is {0,1,2,3,5,6,9,10,13,14,16,17,18}. The residues this device can never output are the complement in {0,...,18}: {4,7,8,11,12,15}.
END WORKING ANSWER
